products.title: Black-Dial Steel Watch
products.descriptionHtml: A classic three-hand watch with a matte black dial, applied silver indices and a 40 mm brushed stainless steel case. The sapphire-coated crystal resists everyday scratches, and the quick-release strap system lets you switch between the included black leather strap and any standard 20 mm band. Water resistant to 50 metres, so a rainy commute or a washed hand is no problem.

seo.description: 40 mm stainless steel watch with a matte black dial, sapphire-coated crystal and quick-release leather strap. Water resistant to 50 m.

products.title: Colorblock Leather Satchel
products.descriptionHtml: A structured black leather satchel with colorful side panels in mustard, teal and rust. The top handle and detachable shoulder strap let you carry it by hand or across the body, and the magnetic flap keeps your phone, wallet and a small tablet secure. Inside there are two slip pockets and a zipped compartment for keys and cards. Finished with brushed brass hardware that softens with use.

products.title: Gold Tin Candle
products.descriptionHtml: A small travel candle poured into a brushed gold tin, scented with amber, cedar and a hint of orange peel. The soy wax blend burns cleanly for around 25 hours, and the lid makes it easy to take on weekends away or keep in a desk drawer. Once finished, the tin is ideal for pins, rings or earrings. Hand poured in small batches.

products.title: Purple Varsity Jacket
products.descriptionHtml: A vintage-inspired varsity jacket in deep purple wool with cream contrast sleeves, a striped rib collar and snap-button front. The relaxed fit layers easily over a hoodie, and the quilted lining keeps it warm on cold autumn evenings. Chenille patch details and two welt pockets finish the classic campus look without feeling like a costume.

products.title: Saddle Leather Crossbody Bag
products.descriptionHtml: A compact crossbody bag in warm saddle-brown leather with an adjustable strap and antique brass buckle. It holds the everyday essentials, phone, cardholder, keys and sunglasses, without the bulk of a full handbag. The leather is vegetable-tanned, so it darkens and develops a rich patina over time. A zipped back pocket keeps your transit card within easy reach.

products.title: Two-Tone Entry Bench
products.descriptionHtml: A slim entryway bench in natural and smoked pine with tapered legs and a lower slatted shelf for shoes. It gives you a place to sit while you lace up, and the shelf keeps the hallway tidy. The bench seats two adults comfortably and is built from sustainably sourced pine with a durable matte lacquer that wipes clean. Simple assembly with four bolts.

seo.title: Two-Tone Pine Entry Bench with Shoe Shelf

products.title: Two-Tone Varsity Jacket
products.descriptionHtml: A two-tone varsity jacket in navy and off-white with a clean, minimal front and ribbed cuffs. It is cut from a wool blend that holds its shape through daily wear, with a soft quilted lining and snap closure. Easy to pair with jeans and trainers for the weekend or with chinos when the evening turns cooler. Two side pockets keep your hands warm.

seo.title: Two-Tone Varsity Jacket | Navy and Off-White
seo.description: Vintage-inspired varsity jacket with wool body, contrast sleeves and chenille details. Relaxed fit, available in S to XL.

products.title: Walnut Wall Shelf
products.descriptionHtml: A compact floating shelf in solid walnut with rounded front corners and a hidden steel bracket. At 60 cm wide it fits above a desk, beside a bed or in a narrow hallway, and it carries up to 10 kg of books, plants and ceramics. Each shelf is finished with a natural oil that brings out the grain and is easy to refresh at home. Wall fixings are included.

seo.title: Walnut Wall Shelf | Solid Wood Floating Shelf
seo.description: Solid walnut floating shelf, 60 cm wide, with a hidden steel bracket and natural oil finish. Holds up to 10 kg. Fixings included.

products.title: Wave Bowl

Use it for fruit on the kitchen counter, keys by the door or as a centrepiece on an oak console. Food safe and dishwasher safe, 24 cm across.
